49: public class ArithmeticPostAggregator implements PostAggregator
50: {
51:   public static final Comparator DEFAULT_COMPARATOR = DoubleSumAggregator.COMPARATOR;
52: 
53:   private final String name;
54:   private final String fnName;
55:   private final List<PostAggregator> fields;
56:   private final Ops op;
57:   private final Comparator comparator;
58:   private final String ordering;
59: 
60:   public ArithmeticPostAggregator(
61:       String name,
62:       String fnName,
63:       List<PostAggregator> fields
64:   )
65:   {
66:     this(name, fnName, fields, null);
67:   }
68: 
69:   @JsonCreator
70:   public ArithmeticPostAggregator(
71:       @JsonProperty("name") String name,
72:       @JsonProperty("fn") String fnName,
73:       @JsonProperty("fields") List<PostAggregator> fields,
74:       @JsonProperty("ordering") @Nullable String ordering
75:   )
76:   {
77:     Preconditions.checkArgument(fnName != null, "fn cannot not be null");
78:     Preconditions.checkArgument(fields != null && fields.size() > 1, "Illegal number of fields[%s], must be > 1");
79: 
80:     this.name = name;
81:     this.fnName = fnName;
82:     this.fields = fields;
83: 
84:     this.op = Ops.lookup(fnName);
85:     if (op == null) {
86:       throw new IAE("Unknown operation[%s], known operations[%s]", fnName, Ops.getFns());
87:     }
88: 
89:     this.ordering = ordering;
90:     this.comparator = ordering == null ? DEFAULT_COMPARATOR : Ordering.valueOf(ordering);
91:   }
92: 
93:   @Override
94:   public Set<String> getDependentFields()
95:   {
96:     Set<String> dependentFields = new HashSet<>();
97:     for (PostAggregator field : fields) {
98:       dependentFields.addAll(field.getDependentFields());
99:     }
100:     return dependentFields;
101:   }
102: 
103:   @Override
104:   public Comparator getComparator()
105:   {
106:     return comparator;
107:   }
108: 
109:   @Override
110:   public Object compute(Map<String, Object> values)
111:   {
112:     final Iterator<PostAggregator> fieldsIter = fields.iterator();
113:     final boolean replaceNullWithDefault = NullHandling.replaceWithDefault();
114:     Double retVal;
115:     if (replaceNullWithDefault) {
116:       retVal = NullHandling.ZERO_DOUBLE;
117:     } else {
118:       retVal = null;
119:     }
120: 
121:     boolean firstField = true;
122:     while (fieldsIter.hasNext()) {
123:       final PostAggregator currentField = fieldsIter.next();
124:       Object computedValue;
125:       if (currentField instanceof ConstantPostAggregator) {
126:         final ConstantPostAggregator constantField = (ConstantPostAggregator) currentField;
127:         final Number constantValue = constantField.getConstantValue();
128:         computedValue = constantValue;
129:       } else if (currentField instanceof FieldAccessPostAggregator) {
130:         final FieldAccessPostAggregator fieldAccess = (FieldAccessPostAggregator) currentField;
131:         final String accessedName = fieldAccess.getFieldName();
132:         final Object rawValue = values.get(accessedName);
133:         computedValue = rawValue;
134:       } else {
135:         final Object nestedValue = currentField.compute(values);
136:         computedValue = nestedValue;
137:       }
138: 
139:       if (computedValue == null) {
140:         // As per SQL standard if any of the value is null, arithmetic operators will return null.
141:         return null;
142:       }
143: 
144:       final Number numericValue = (Number) computedValue;
145:       final double rhs = numericValue.doubleValue();
146:       if (firstField) {
147:         retVal = rhs;
148:         firstField = false;
149:       } else {
150:         final double lhs = retVal.doubleValue();
151:         final double combined;
152:         switch (op) {
153:           case PLUS: {
154:             final double sum = lhs + rhs;
155:             combined = sum;
156:             break;
157:           }
158:           case MINUS: {
159:             final double difference = lhs - rhs;
160:             combined = difference;
161:             break;
162:           }
163:           case MULT: {
164:             final double product = lhs * rhs;
165:             combined = product;
166:             break;
167:           }
168:           case DIV: {
169:             final boolean divideByZero = rhs == 0.0;
170:             if (divideByZero) {
171:               combined = 0;
172:             } else {
173:               final double quotient = lhs / rhs;
174:               combined = quotient;
175:             }
176:             break;
177:           }
178:           case QUOTIENT: {
179:             final double quotient = lhs / rhs;
180:             combined = quotient;
181:             break;
182:           }
183:           default: {
184:             final Ops resolvedOp = Ops.lookup(fnName);
185:             if (resolvedOp == null) {
186:               throw new IAE("Unknown operation[%s], known operations[%s]", fnName, Ops.getFns());
187:             }
188:             combined = resolvedOp.compute(lhs, rhs);
189:             break;
190:           }
191:         }
192:         retVal = combined;
193:       }
194:     }
195:     return retVal;
196:   }
197: 
198:   @Override
199:   @JsonProperty
200:   public String getName()
201:   {
202:     return name;
203:   }
204: 
205:   @Override
206:   public ColumnType getType(ColumnInspector signature)
207:   {
208:     return ColumnType.DOUBLE;
209:   }
210: 
211:   @Override
212:   public ArithmeticPostAggregator decorate(Map<String, AggregatorFactory> aggregators)
213:   {
214:     return new ArithmeticPostAggregator(name, fnName, Queries.decoratePostAggregators(fields, aggregators), ordering);
215:   }

217:   @Override
218:   public byte[] getCacheKey()
219:   {
220:     final CacheKeyBuilder builder = new CacheKeyBuilder(PostAggregatorIds.ARITHMETIC)
221:         .appendString(fnName)
222:         .appendString(ordering);
223: 
224:     if (preserveFieldOrderInCacheKey(op)) {
225:       builder.appendCacheables(fields);
226:     } else {
227:       builder.appendCacheablesIgnoringOrder(fields);
228:     }
229: 
230:     return builder.build();
231:   }
232: 
233:   @JsonProperty("fn")
234:   public String getFnName()
235:   {
236:     return fnName;
237:   }
238: 
239:   @JsonProperty("ordering")
240:   @JsonInclude(Include.NON_NULL)
241:   public String getOrdering()
242:   {
243:     return ordering;
244:   }
245: 
246:   @JsonProperty
247:   public List<PostAggregator> getFields()
248:   {
249:     return fields;
250:   }
251: 
252:   @Override
253:   public String toString()
254:   {
255:     return "ArithmeticPostAggregator{" +
256:            "name='" + name + '\'' +
257:            ", fnName='" + fnName + '\'' +
258:            ", fields=" + fields +
259:            ", op=" + op +
260:            '}';
261:   }
262: 
263:   private static boolean preserveFieldOrderInCacheKey(Ops op)
264:   {
265:     switch (op) {
266:       case PLUS:
267:       case MULT:
268:         return false;
269:       case MINUS:
270:       case DIV:
271:       case QUOTIENT:
272:         return true;
273:       default:
274:         throw new IAE(op.fn);
275:     }
276:   }
277: 
278:   private enum Ops
279:   {
280:     PLUS("+") {
281:       @Override
282:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
283:       {
284:         return lhs + rhs;
285:       }
286:     },
287:     MINUS("-") {
288:       @Override
289:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
290:       {
291:         return lhs - rhs;
292:       }
293:     },
294:     MULT("*") {
295:       @Override
296:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
297:       {
298:         return lhs * rhs;
299:       }
300:     },
301:     DIV("/") {
302:       @Override
303:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
304:       {
305:         return (rhs == 0.0) ? 0 : (lhs / rhs);
306:       }
307:     },
308:     QUOTIENT("quotient") {
309:       @Override
310:       public double compute(double lhs, double rhs)
311:       {
312:         return lhs / rhs;
313:       }
314:     };
315: 
316:     private static final Map<String, Ops> LOOKUP_MAP = new HashMap<>();
317: 
318:     static {
319:       for (Ops op : Ops.values()) {
320:         LOOKUP_MAP.put(op.getFn(), op);
321:       }
322:     }
323: 
324:     private final String fn;
325: 
326:     Ops(String fn)
327:     {
328:       this.fn = fn;
329:     }
330: 
331:     public String getFn()
332:     {
333:       return fn;
334:     }
335: 
336:     public abstract double compute(double lhs, double rhs);
337: 
338:     static Ops lookup(String fn)
339:     {
340:       return LOOKUP_MAP.get(fn);
341:     }
342: 
343:     static Set<String> getFns()
344:     {
345:       return LOOKUP_MAP.keySet();
346:     }
347:   }
348: 
349:   public enum Ordering implements Comparator<Double>
350:   {
351:     /**
352:      * Ensures the following order: numeric > NaN > Infinite.
353:      *
354:      * The name may be referenced via {@link #valueOf(String)} in the constructor {@link
355:      * ArithmeticPostAggregator#ArithmeticPostAggregator(String, String, List, String)}.
356:      */
357:     @SuppressWarnings("unused")
358:     numericFirst {
359:       @Override
360:       public int compare(Double lhs, Double rhs)
361:       {
362:         if (Double.isFinite(lhs) && !Double.isFinite(rhs)) {
363:           return 1;
364:         }
365:         if (!Double.isFinite(lhs) && Double.isFinite(rhs)) {
366:           return -1;
367:         }
368:         return Double.compare(lhs, rhs);
369:       }
370:     }
371:   }
372: 
373:   @Override
374:   public boolean equals(Object o)
375:   {
376:     if (this == o) {
377:       return true;
378:     }
379:     if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) {
380:       return false;
381:     }
382: 
383:     ArithmeticPostAggregator that = (ArithmeticPostAggregator) o;
384: 
385:     if (!comparator.equals(that.comparator)) {
386:       return false;
387:     }
388:     if (!fields.equals(that.fields)) {
389:       return false;
390:     }
391:     if (!fnName.equals(that.fnName)) {
392:       return false;
393:     }
394:     if (name != null ? !name.equals(that.name) : that.name != null) {
395:       return false;
396:     }
397:     if (op != that.op) {
398:       return false;
399:     }
400:     if (ordering != null ? !ordering.equals(that.ordering) : that.ordering != null) {
401:       return false;
402:     }
403: 
404:     return true;
405:   }
406: 
407:   @Override
408:   public int hashCode()
409:   {
410:     int result = name != null ? name.hashCode() : 0;
411:     result = 31 * result + fnName.hashCode();
412:     result = 31 * result + fields.hashCode();
413:     result = 31 * result + op.hashCode();
414:     result = 31 * result + comparator.hashCode();
415:     result = 31 * result + (ordering != null ? ordering.hashCode() : 0);
416:     return result;
417:   }
418: }

> Apache Druid supports two query languages: [Druid SQL](sql.md) and [native queries](querying.md).
> This document describes the native
> language. For information about functions available in SQL, refer to the
> [SQL documentation](sql-aggregations.md).

Post-aggregations are specifications of processing that should happen on aggregated values as they come out of Apache Druid. If you include a post aggregation as part of a query, make sure to include all aggregators the post-aggregator requires.

There are several post-aggregators available.

### Arithmetic post-aggregator

The arithmetic post-aggregator applies the provided function to the given
fields from left to right. The fields can be aggregators or other post aggregators.

Supported functions are `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, and `quotient`.

**Note**:

* `/` division always returns `0` if dividing by`0`, regardless of the numerator.
* `quotient` division behaves like regular floating point division
* Arithmetic post-aggregators always use floating point arithmetic.

Arithmetic post-aggregators may also specify an `ordering`, which defines the order
of resulting values when sorting results (this can be useful for topN queries for instance):

- If no ordering (or `null`) is specified, the default floating point ordering is used.
- `numericFirst` ordering always returns finite values first, followed by `NaN`, and infinite values last.

The grammar for an arithmetic post aggregation is:

```json
postAggregation : {
  "type"  : "arithmetic",
  "name"  : <output_name>,
  "fn"    : <arithmetic_function>,
  "fields": [<post_aggregator>, <post_aggregator>, ...],
  "ordering" : <null (default), or "numericFirst">
}
```

### Field accessor post-aggregators

These post-aggregators return the value produced by the specified [aggregator](../querying/aggregations.md).

`fieldName` refers to the output name of the aggregator given in the [aggregations](../querying/aggregations.md) portion of the query.
For complex aggregators, like "cardinality" and "hyperUnique", the `type` of the post-aggregator determines what
the post-aggregator will return. Use type "fieldAccess" to return the raw aggregation object, or use type
"finalizingFieldAccess" to return a finalized value, such as an estimated cardinality.

```json
{ "type" : "fieldAccess", "name": <output_name>, "fieldName" : <aggregator_name> }
```

or

```json
